name: HT7533-1
title: HT75xx-1: 30 V, 100 mA low-power fixed-output LDO regulators
summary: A family of three-terminal CMOS linear regulators with fixed outputs from 2.1 V to 12.0 V, accepting up to 30 V at the input and drawing 2.5 µA typical quiescent current. Output accuracy is ±3%, and the parts deliver 100 mA typical (70 mA minimum) on the low-voltage codes, more on the 5 V and higher codes. Offered in SOT89 and SOT23-5. HT7533-1 is the 3.3 V member.

circuits.title: Basic circuit
circuits.description: The regulator alone with a 10 µF polarised capacitor from input to ground and another from output to ground. Input and output commons meet the regulator's GND pin at one ground point.

circuits.title: High output current positive voltage regulator
circuits.description: A PNP pass transistor carries load current around the regulator. Its emitter sits on the raw input, its collector on the output, and its base on the regulator's input node, which R1 feeds from the raw input.

circuits.title: Short-circuit protection for Tr1
circuits.description: The high-current circuit with a current limit on the pass transistor. Sense resistor Rs sits in Tr1's emitter lead; a second PNP, Tr2, has its emitter on the raw input, its base at the Rs-Tr1 emitter node and its collector on Tr1's base.

circuits.title: Circuit for increasing output voltage, resistor divider
circuits.description: The regulator's GND pin is lifted off common by a variable resistor R2. R1 sits across the regulator's fixed output VXX, so the current in R1 plus the quiescent current ISS flows down R2; the output is VXX plus the drop across R2. C1 and C2 return to the GND-pin node, not to common.

parts.note: variable; wiper tied to the end on common

circuits.title: Circuit for increasing output voltage, Zener
circuits.description: A Zener diode D1 lifts the regulator's GND pin above common, cathode to the GND pin and anode to common, so the output is the fixed voltage VXX plus the Zener voltage. R1 sits across VXX from output to the GND-pin node; C1 and C2 also return to that node.

circuits.title: Constant current regulator
circuits.description: The regulator holds its fixed voltage VXX across RA, and the GND pin is the current output. The load RL runs from the GND-pin node to common and carries VXX/RA plus the quiescent current ISS. C1 and C2 return to the GND-pin node.

circuits.title: Dual supply
circuits.description: Two regulators share one input. IC2's output is the lower output; IC1's GND pin stands on that output, so IC1's output is the upper output, IC2's voltage plus IC1's. R1 runs from the lower output to common, C2 and C3 decouple the lower and upper outputs, and a diode runs from the lower output (anode) to the upper output (cathode) across IC1.

where.VXX: fixed output voltage of the regulator, between VOUT and GND
where.R1: resistor from VOUT to the GND pin
where.R2: resistor from the GND pin to common
where.ISS: quiescent current out of the GND pin

operation.text: A three-terminal CMOS linear regulator with a fixed output, taking up to 30 V in and drawing 2.5 µA typical with no load. Output codes run from 2.1 V to 12.0 V, each within ±3%. Added external parts give a higher output voltage or a regulated current.

A P-channel pass transistor runs from VIN to VOUT. An error amplifier compares a reference, biased by a current source from VIN, against a resistor divider on VOUT and drives the pass transistor's gate.

Parts from 2.1 V to 4.4 V supply 70 mA minimum, 100 mA typical, with load regulation specified from 1 mA to 50 mA. HT7550-1 supplies 100 mA minimum, 150 mA typical; parts from 6.0 V to 12.0 V are specified at 150 mA minimum. From 5.0 V up, load regulation is specified from 1 mA to 70 mA.
Dropout is measured at 1 mA load: 30 mV typical, 100 mV maximum for parts up to 3.0 V; 25 mV typical, 55 mV maximum from 3.3 V up.
The quiescent current ISS leaves through the GND pin. Where the GND pin is lifted off common or used as a current output, ISS adds to the result.
In the basic, high-current, short-circuit-protected and raised-output circuits, the input common, the output common and the regulator's ground return meet at a single ground point.
At 25 °C ambient the SOT23-5 handles 0.20 W and the SOT89 0.50 W, with junction-to-ambient resistance of 500 °C/W and 200 °C/W respectively, measured in still air with no heat sink.
